case_number: 2025 INSC 170; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP (Crl) No.7712 OF 2022)
summary: Murder conviction based on circumstantial evidence; key prosecution witnesses turned hostile; medical evidence inconclusive on cause of death (asphyxia vs. tuberculosis); ligature marks possibly from transportation; recovered rope not uniquely linked to crime; prosecution failed to establish chain of guilt beyond reasonable doubt; principles from Sharad Birdhichand Sarda applied; Section 106 Evidence Act burden does not shift unless prosecution makes prima facie case; Anees v. State of NCT cited; conviction set aside due to benefit of doubt.
legal_provisions_cited: Sharad Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Maharashtra
Anees v. The State Govt. of NCT
Trimukh Maroti Kirkan v. State of Maharashtra
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant acquitted.
